_notes: Reviewed extras (TAG-078, ADR-0023, ADR-0030): real genres Discogs lacks, each with parents, a list of canonical names or family names: parents[0] is the primary parent (a family name makes the genre a direct child of that family) and decides the family; further entries are extra parents. The optional family overrides the family derived from parents[0] (space disco: under disco, which is a Funk / Soul genre, but a genre of Electronic). Entries are reviewed in git; 'electronic' is not a genre (the group Others replaced the Electronic family) and is not listed here.
Origin: the kept sub-genres of TAG-076 and the manual parents of GEN-045, plus library tags that are real genres Discogs does not list (reviewed 2026-10-16). note says where each came from.
